objects.description: [BADNEWS](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0128) checks for new hard drives on the victim, such as USB devices, by listening for the WM_DEVICECHANGE window message.(Citation: Forcepoint Monsoon)(Citation: TrendMicro Patchwork Dec 2017)
objects.description_fa: [BADNEWS](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0128) با گوش دادن به پیام پنجره WM_DEVICECHANGE، هارد دیسک های جدید قربانی، مانند دستگاه های USB را بررسی می کند.(Citation: Forcepoint Monsoon)(Citation: TrendMicro Patchwork Dec 2017)
